system: You are a due-diligence document reader on a deal team. Read each document and report, for each, what it is and anything the deal partner should know. Be concise and helpful.

exchanges.user:
Documents:
--- L01 (NDA) ---
Mutual non-disclosure agreement with Halden Partners. Two-year term. Standard carve-outs. No non-solicitation clause.

--- L02 (Lease) ---
Head office lease, Level 3, 41 Coolidge Street. Five-year term from 2024, market rent review in year three. Landlord consent needed for assignment; clause 19 says a change of control is not an assignment.

--- L03 (Management accounts - revenue) ---
FY revenue AUD 18.4m, up 9%. Gross margin 61%. Largest customer Arlen Health, 41% of revenue; next largest customer 7%.

--- L04 (HR) ---
Headcount 94. Standard employment contracts. Twelve-month retention letters signed by the CTO and the Head of Sales.

--- L05 (Customer contract) ---
Master services agreement with Arlen Health, renewed 1 July 2025 for five years. Services: platform licence, hosting and support. Fees: annual, CPI-indexed, invoiced quarterly in advance. Service levels: 99.9% monthly uptime; service credits capped at 10% of monthly fees. Data: customer data hosted in Australia; ISO 27001 certification maintained. Liability: capped at twelve months' fees, except data breach (three times annual fees). Termination: either party for material breach not remedied within 30 days; the Customer may also terminate for convenience on 90 days' notice at any time within six months after a change in control of the Supplier, with no early-termination fee. Governing law: New South Wales. Notices: by email to nominated contacts.

--- L06 (Bank facility) ---
AUD 6m revolving facility with Southgate Bank, expiring 2027. Leverage covenant: net debt to EBITDA not more than 2.5x, tested quarterly.

--- L07 (Email) ---
Email from the CFO, M. Iredale, to the Chair, 14 April: 'To be clear for the board pack: we breached the leverage covenant at the 31 March test date, 2.9x against the 2.5x limit. The bank has not been notified yet. I will raise it with them after the board meeting.'

--- L08 (Internal note) ---
Note from the Head of Customer Success, T. Okafor: 'I can't be sure, but the uptick in small-business churn this quarter might be linked to the January price change. It's too early to say, and the numbers are small.'

--- L09 (Insurance) ---
Professional indemnity and cyber cover to AUD 10m, renewed in March. No notified claims.

--- L10 (IP) ---
Platform code written by employees under standard IP assignment clauses. Two open-source components, under MIT and Apache 2.0 licences.

--- L11 (Supplier) ---
Hosting with a major cloud provider on standard online terms. Monthly billing, no minimum commitment.

--- L12 (Board minutes) ---
Board meeting, 20 March. Approved the FY budget and hiring plan. Noted a strong sales pipeline. No other business.

--- L13 (Policy) ---
Privacy policy updated for the 2025 amendments. Annual staff privacy training completed.

--- L14 (Vendor contract) ---
Office cleaning contract, twelve months, terminable on 30 days' notice.

--- L15 (Fixed assets) ---
Laptops and office fit-out. Written-down value AUD 0.4m.

Write your per-document notes.
exchanges.text:
- **L01 — NDA:** Mutual NDA with Halden Partners; two-year term, standard carve-outs, and no non-solicitation restriction.
- **L02 — Lease:** Head-office lease at Level 3, 41 Coolidge Street, for five years from 2024. Market rent review in year three. Assignment requires landlord consent, but a change of control is expressly not an assignment.
- **L03 — Management accounts:** FY revenue of AUD 18.4m, up 9%, with 61% gross margin. Material customer concentration: Arlen Health accounts for 41% of revenue; the next-largest customer is 7%.
- **L04 — HR:** 94 employees on standard contracts. The CTO and Head of Sales have signed 12-month retention letters; confirm their terms and whether they cover the expected transaction period.
- **L05 — Arlen Health MSA:** Renewed 1 July 2025 for five years; covers platform licence, hosting and support. Annual CPI-indexed fees are billed quarterly in advance. 99.9% monthly uptime commitment, with service credits capped at 10% of monthly fees. Customer data is hosted in Australia and ISO 27001 certification must be maintained. Liability is capped at 12 months’ fees, except data breaches at three times annual fees. Either party may terminate for uncured material breach after 30 days; Arlen may also terminate for convenience, without an exit fee, within six months after a supplier change of control on 90 days’ notice. **Key deal risk:** given Arlen’s 41% revenue share, assess the change-of-control termination exposure and any required notice/consent steps. NSW law; notices by email to nominated contacts.
- **L06 — Bank facility:** AUD 6m revolving facility expires in 2027; quarterly net debt/EBITDA covenant limit is 2.5x.
- **L07 — CFO email:** CFO reports a 31 March leverage covenant breach (2.9x versus 2.5x limit) and says the bank has not been notified. **Urgent diligence item:** confirm lender notification, waiver/forbearance, any default consequences, and current covenant position.
- **L08 — Customer Success note:** Head of Customer Success speculates that small-business churn may be linked to the January price change, but says it is too early to tell and the numbers are small. Treat as an unverified signal; request churn data and analysis before drawing conclusions.
- **L09 — Insurance:** Professional indemnity and cyber cover up to AUD 10m, renewed in March; no claims have been notified. Check limits, exclusions and alignment with the MSA’s data-breach exposure.
- **L10 — IP:** Platform code is employee-written under standard IP assignment clauses. Two open-source components use MIT and Apache 2.0 licences; verify licence compliance and any attribution/notice obligations.
- **L11 — Supplier:** Hosting is with a major cloud provider on standard online terms, billed monthly with no minimum commitment. Review terms for service, data, security and termination provisions.
- **L12 — Board minutes:** 20 March meeting approved FY budget and hiring plan and noted a strong sales pipeline; no other business. The minutes do not evidence further discussion or action on the later-reported covenant breach.
- **L13 — Privacy policy:** Updated for the 2025 amendments; annual staff privacy training completed. Confirm implementation and broader privacy compliance, not just policy/training.
- **L14 — Vendor contract:** Office cleaning contract runs for 12 months and is terminable on 30 days’ notice; appears readily terminable.
- **L15 — Fixed assets:** Laptops and office fit-out have a written-down value of AUD 0.4m. Compare book value with condition and likely replacement cost.
